authorization: 用户要求修复该能力提升提示并全库检查、处理因已滚出名字而无法翻译的同类情况；仅上述25种精确窗口使用已核对的独立正文，原译文和变量保留。
policy: Use the independent body only when the original display still needs a missing name after current binding and permitted PLAYER reuse; otherwise retain the original display.
limitations: Counts describe saved source-window patterns, not every possible live input, arbitrary name fill or partial-character rendering.
Removal of the missing-name requirement does not bypass other candidate conflicts, variable kinds or incomplete source matches.
The remaining 300 missing-current-variable windows include future names, item/numeric values and localization-added PLAYER; they are not all rolled-name defects.
Source Chinese meanings are retained; unrelated localization wording discrepancies are outside this change.
